parsed.answer: As of August 22, Ivo’s Cobalt project uses STREAM-1-286, the delivery switch approved on August 15 and retained on August 22. Its retry policy is RETRY-1-907, which supersedes RETRY-1-108. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8 (REPLAY-1-632 was tested and restored missing updates).

citations.quote: Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision.
2026-08-22. Ivo reviewed Cobalt. Keep the August 15 delivery choice.
The retry policy is now RETRY-1-907, superseding RETRY-1-108.
For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.
The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates.
